selector: An outcome earns a slot when surviving it requires a shape the learner does not already own. The unit is the recovery shape, not the outcome’s name.

attestation_classes.minted: Attested nowhere in either corpus; must be minted outright
attestation_classes.method-pod-only: Attested in the Method Pod only, with no g<n> support
attestation_classes.thin: Attested thinly in pod-1 — once, or once in one scene

sequence_basis: Redemption latency — how many turns the learner is stuck before the recovery lands.

not_selected.name: Question back (F3)
not_selected.why: Eight dialogic attestations with the learner taking them up every time. The learner owns it.

not_selected.name: The licence pair
not_selected.why: Attested once (g221→g222) and granted. The missing refusal branch is O1 on a different mask, and the shape transfers. See U7.

not_selected.name: Negotiate-the-when
not_selected.why: Carried inside O9’s counter-offer; no separate scene.

not_selected.name: Comply-with-read-back as a move
not_selected.why: The move is attested twice and is free; only the correction inside the confirm earns O4.

not_selected.name: Every happy-path family
not_selected.why: Twenty-two variations of the happy path have already shipped.

outcome_shapes.name: Non-delivery with a reason
outcome_shapes.recovery_the_learner_must_own: Absorb the no; re-select, or ask what is possible
outcome_shapes.attested: Drill only — g158–g161; every dialogic refusal (g15, g59, g84, g108, g136, g21, g22) arrives with an account and a substitute
outcome_shapes.why_there: No-cash-only is unmistakable; the wrong turn is widest where the learner has already received the goods. The seed specimen is already written for this ask

outcome_shapes.name: Nobody knows
outcome_shapes.recovery_the_learner_must_own: Re-route the ask — another person, another means
outcome_shapes.attested: Method Pod only — M:1:54, M:4:70, M:4:77
outcome_shapes.why_there: The corpus’s longest chain, and the place being stranded mid-instruction is most obvious. g90 "you’ll have to look to make sure" is the nearest thing pod-1 has and it delegates rather than fails

outcome_shapes.name: The native does not understand you
outcome_shapes.recovery_the_learner_must_own: Reformulate your own turn — shorter, slower — and check it landed
outcome_shapes.attested: Nowhere. Absent from pod-1; explicitly unattestable in the Method corpus
outcome_shapes.why_there: The shortest, most drilled ticket the learner owns. Failure on the one sentence they are surest of is unmistakable, and the recovery is one turn

outcome_shapes.name: Your read-back was wrong
outcome_shapes.recovery_the_learner_must_own: Take the correction and read back again
outcome_shapes.attested: Thinly — g121→g122→g123, once, and the correction is silent
outcome_shapes.why_there: The receptionist already reads back. Numbers, nights and dates make a mis-hearing concrete and checkable in one turn

outcome_shapes.name: The premise of your ask is wrong
outcome_shapes.recovery_the_learner_must_own: Drop the premise; ask the prior question
outcome_shapes.sited_on: Transport — the bus/boat drill frame, g177–g179
outcome_shapes.why_there: A wrong premise is visible in one sentence: there is no bus today, the boat does not run in winter. The learner already owns the ask

outcome_shapes.name: Trouble that is your own fault
outcome_shapes.recovery_the_learner_must_own: Admit it, supply what you can, accept the consequence
outcome_shapes.attested: Nowhere as an exchange. g182, g183 supply the material as monologue with no partner turn
outcome_shapes.why_there: The material is already written and already learner-side. All that is missing is the other party

outcome_shapes.name: The native discloses worry or difficulty
outcome_shapes.attested: Nowhere. g186, g187 are the learner disclosing, in drill. g110→g111 is the corpus answering trouble with an elicit — the starkest absence of sympathy in the canon
outcome_shapes.why_there: The register shift is largest against a transactional frame, and the scene is already about a body

outcome_shapes.name: You are disagreed with
outcome_shapes.attested: Method Pod, in the parked form only — M:2:386→2:401, M:4:148→4:152. pod-1 attests disagreement only with a person’s account of themselves (g226, g228), never about the world
outcome_shapes.why_there: Order the thing the waiter advised against. A one-turn wrong turn with a visible fork, and the shape is already built

outcome_shapes.name: A second no
outcome_shapes.recovery_the_learner_must_own: Produce a third position, or yield
outcome_shapes.why_there: The corpus’s only two-sided negotiation. Extending its own scene by one refusal is the smallest possible mint
